query: within-run and across-run adaptation agent training
LLM agent training environment evolves with policy
text:
1. **SEAL: Synergistic Co-Evolution of Agents and Learning Environments** — The closest match: it jointly evolves an LLM agent’s policy and its training environment. **People:** Yihao Hu, Zhihao Wen, Xiujin Liu, Pan Wang, Xin Zhang, Wei Wu. **Affiliations:** Ant Group, Westlake University, University of Michigan–Ann Arbor, and University of Science and Technology of China. [URL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24426)

2. **COvolve: Adversarial Co-Evolution of Large-Language-Model-Generated Policies and Environments via Two-Player Zero-Sum Game** — Uses LLMs to generate and adversarially co-evolve both policies and environments. **People:** Alkis Sygkounas, Rishi Hazra, Andreas Persson, Pedro Zuidberg Dos Martires, Amy Loutfi. **Affiliation:** Machine Perception and Interaction Lab, Örebro University, Sweden. [URL](https://pedrozudo.github.io/assets/documents/publications/2026/sygkounas2026covolve/sygkounas2026covolve.paper.pdf)

3. **CoEvolve: Training LLM Agents via Agent-Data Mutual Evolution** — Makes the training-task distribution evolve in response to the policy’s failures, uncertainty, and forgetting. **People:** Shidong Yang, Ziyu Ma, Tongwen Huang, Yiming Hu, Yong Wang, Xiangxiang Chu. **Affiliation:** AMAP, Alibaba Group. [URL](https://aclanthology.org/2026.acl-long.1055/)

4. **Agent0: Unleashing Self-Evolving Agents from Zero Data via Tool-Integrated Reasoning** — Co-evolves a curriculum-generating agent and an executor policy, with harder tasks emerging as the executor improves. **People:** Peng Xia, Kaide Zeng, Jiaqi Liu, Can Qin, Fang Wu, Yiyang Zhou, Caiming Xiong, Huaxiu Yao. **Affiliations:** UNC–Chapel Hill, Salesforce Research, and Stanford University. [URL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.16043)
